To identify the target playlist, I need to search all private and public playlists for the exact title, so I will paginate through every result.

```python
playlist_results = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.search_playlists(query='Woodstock Reimagined: Festival Vibes', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    playlist_results.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print(playlist_results)
```
